test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. Only two people sit to the left of C. Only two people sit between A and B. B sits to the left of A. E is an immediate neighbour of A to the right. Only one person sits to the right of D. F is not an immediate neighbour of B. How many people sit between E and B?
solution:
Explanation:

Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. 

1) Only two people sit to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77890366eb902e9973876fa0b9f41e76b54d09bf7f48616a7d3e178ac957155d.png] 

2) Only two people sit between A and B. B sits to the left of A.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27dfa1eea3992b090d74ad50285894f33c06eab7d83284b9d309a26d1d11f4a9.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/037e933e4067d3ea3fac055ae94e46fc42a4214a75fd8ed7a448669e22e8bb99.png] 

Case (iii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6db95d3929d79d3817146ac27d8a0cd8f0f30fa9491367d37577463ba4bdf5c8.png] 

3) E is an immediate neighbour of A to the right.

So, here case (iii) gets eliminated.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d3cec4c4bf3fd5d286189ae0da1a50db6b48b4d21fc44ea6a103a3dee7ca2bd.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4b50800bdbeff043686d002f726673cf88ee31259e59bda8cebdbc1122c7603.png] 

4) Only one person sits to the right of D.

So, here case (ii) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffd41d57f6f18ad1af2aa47f9145a73e21b44d0c64f624958b20d0b00315f742.png] 

5) F is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96c6b73b3b4f1e856927ca928e0385d48da8c4bcfcf4a6de301d09dffe92e452.png] 

∴ Here, three people sit between E and B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Three".
